title.narrative: FUNDO CASA PAYMENT 2024 CASA INDIGENA PROGRAM

description.narrative: Over the last three years, this project, co-funded by Ireland and Norway, aims to support Indigenous peoples to expand their role in the autonomous governance, protection and sustainable management of their territories through access to means to strengthen their organisations and defend their rights. The programme works with and supports Indigenous organisations to directly access resources and implement their own priorities in the areas of organisational strengthening, environmental management, territorial governance and defence of rights. As this relates to the Amazon region, the advance of environmental management is supporting biodiversity and through strengthening of Indigenous organisations in the Amazon, this aids in our mitigation support as strengthening territorial protections reduces carbon in the atmosphere
